sourceTitle: Ginger Flower Buds Remedy for Arthritis ( 姜花治关节炎 )
sourceText:
Ginger Flower Buds Remedy for Arthritis ( 姜花治关节炎 )
By: Blackswan
Published: Sunday, October 14, 2018 - 12:52am

Ingredients




3 stalks Ginger Flower Buds
3 mugs Water

Preparation

1 Chop of end of stalk. Peel off any brown areas on stalk, and remove any bruised petals. Rinse. 2 Cut stalk into half or about 3 inches, and chop the flower bud into two about 3cm in length. 3 Put the cut Ginger Flower Buds in pot of water and bring to boil. Continue to simmer for about 40 minutes to reduce water to 1 mug. 4 Turn off heat and let it cool. Use a strainer to filter the flowers. To avoid wastage, you may wanna squeeze out the extra juices from the residue.

About

Do you know that Torch Ginger Flower ( 姜花 ) is high in antioxidants, has anti-bacterial properties, & is also used to treat Arthritis ( 关节炎 )?  
When to Drink:
Drink 1 mug 2 to 3 times a day at room temperature after meal.
To see results, try drinking for about 2 weeks.
